name: Ruhollah Khomeini
role: Leader of the Iranian Revolution; first Supreme Leader of Iran (1979-1989)
summary: A Shia cleric who developed the doctrine of guardianship of the Islamic jurist and led the 1979 revolution that replaced Iran's monarchy with a theocratic republic. He held that law comes from God alone, rejected the separation of religion and politics, and opposed Western and Soviet influence.
